correctness.rationale: Direct invariant-moment rederivation: average over S_n and global inversion on H_n. Odd degrees vanish, the degree-two invariant is p₂, and the quartics are spanned by p₂² and p₄ because p₁=0. On the unit sphere p₂=1. The squared coordinates on a vertex have values (n−k)/(nk) and k/[n(n−k)] with multiplicities k and n−k. Thus p₄(u_S)=n/[k(n−k)]−3/n. The squared norm of the projection of e_i to H_n is (n−1)/n; the sphere fourth projection formula in dimension n−1 yields sphere mean p₄=3(n−1)/[n(n+1)]. Equality is exactly the stated criterion and suffices for real or complex polynomials through degree five. The source tensor expansion is consistent: index partitions give A=3−6c₂+3c₄ and B=−2+8c₂−6c₄ using the zero-sum condition. With t=n−2k the criterion becomes (n−1)²−3t²=1. The positive fundamental unit is 2+√3; excluding j=0,1 gives n≥8 and 0<t<n−2, with n−t even from the Pell equation modulo 2. Complements give the opposite choices of k. At k=n/2 the signed multisample has constant multiplicity two and fails the moment condition for n≥4. Confirmed 2 C(27,6)=592020.
